item.title: Clarine A. Pugh
item.description: CONWAY – Clarine Anderson Pugh, 78, of Conway died Monday, January 26, 2026 at ECU Health Medical Center, Greenville. Funeral services will be held at 12 noon on Friday, January 30, 2026 at Zion Hill Missionary Baptist Church, Seaboard. Burial will follow in the church cemetery. T.L. Faison’s Funeral Care, Seaboard, is handling the arrangements.

item.description: EURE – Emma Knight, 72, of Eure died Monday, January 26, 2026. Funeral services will be held at 11 a.m. on Wednesday, February 4, 2026 at Upper Room Assembly Church, Gatesville. Community of Hope Funeral Service, Hobbsville, is handling the arrangements.

item.title: Larry R. Butler
item.description: POWELLSVILLE – Larry R. Butler, 77, of Powellsville died Monday, January 26, 2026. A memorial gathering will be held from 2-5 p.m. on Friday, February 6, 2026 at Quintons Restaurant, Ahoskie. Reynolds Funeral Home, Ahoskie, is handling the arrangements.

item.title: Jerry W. Bunch
item.description: COLERAIN – Jerry Winston Bunch, 83, of Colerain died Tuesday, January 27, 2026 at Ahoskie Health and Rehab, Ahoskie. A graveside service will be held at 2 p.m. on Monday, February 2, 2026 at Hillcrest Cemetery, Colerain. Garrett-Sykes Funeral Service, Ahoskie, is handling the arrangements.

item.title: Lila P. Davenport
item.description: AHOSKIE – Lila Rhea Powell Davenport, aged 93, peacefully departed this life on January 28, 2026, at Ahoskie Health and Rehab in Ahoskie, North Carolina. Lila was born on March 12, 1932, in Hertford County, North Carolina, to her loving parents Sophronia Powell and Mary Trummel Powell. Having spent her entire life in the place she dearly loved, Lila dedicated many years as a unit secretary at Roanoke Chowan Hospital until her retirement.
